test_title: PYST 11: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Gracious
solution:
The correct answer is: **Rude**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"gracious"** means courteous, kind, and pleasant. (अनुग्राही, कृपालु)

 

 
• **Example: **She was gracious in accepting their apologies.

 

 

 
• **"Rude" **refers to being offensively impolite or ill-mannered. (अशिष्ट)

 

 
• **Example: **He was very rude to the waiter for no reason.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'gracious' **is **'rude'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Rude**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mythical **(पौराणिक): Pertaining to or of the nature of a myth; legendary.

 

 
• **Example:** The unicorn is a mythical creature.

 

 

 
• **Keen **(उत्सुक): Having or showing eagerness or enthusiasm.

 

 
• **Example: **She is very keen to learn new languages.

 

 

 
• **Lonely** (अकेला): Sad because one has no friends or company.

 

 
• **Example:** He felt lonely after moving to a new city.

 

 

30:T930,

The correct answer is: **Option 2**.
